name: railyard
description: Publishing review gates, delivery through consumer verification, specialist reviews, and optional fleet coordination.

interface.shortDescription: Delivery, publishing checks, and optional fleet coordination
interface.longDescription: Railyard defines the publishing review and merge checks and can carry an explicitly requested delivery through release or deployment and consumer verification. Compound Engineering coordinates PR review and CI. Fleet coordination, specialist reviews, Oracle, audit, and runtime cleanup are available on demand.
defaultPrompt: Use Railyard to deliver this change through the required release or deployment and verify it at the consumer.
Use Railyard to coordinate this explicitly requested fleet or account workflow.
Run the Railyard doctor for this installation problem.
